card.name: Instruction verbs opening warnings
card.fires_on: The verb or object right after a conditional lead-in in warnings, such as 'inquire' after 'Prior to use,' or 'prescribe' after 'daily,'. Also 'patients' after 'Monitor'.

modes.label: The instruction to inquire about allergy history
modes.description: The verb 'inquire' after a before-therapy lead-in, introducing a check for prior hypersensitivity.
modes.example: Prior to use,<< inquire>> regarding history of hypersensitivity to beta-l

modes.label: The instruction to prescribe alternative therapy
modes.description: The verb 'prescribe' after a statin dose condition, leading to alternative treatment.
modes.example: receiving ZYPITAMAG 4 mg daily,<< prescribe>> alternative LDL-C-lowering treatment.

modes.label: The instruction to monitor patients
modes.description: The word 'patients' right after 'Monitor' in a warning about watching for signs and symptoms.
modes.example: Monitor<< patients>> for signs and symptoms of genitour
